title: Possible county purchase of Maui Land and Pine water assets
summary: Under a non-binding agreement (MOU) signed May 18, 2026, the county is checking and appraising Maui Land and Pineapple water assets in West Maui and Upcountry. The assets include a ditch, tunnels, reservoirs and wells, and the county also wants land for a 100 million gallon reservoir. The council must approve any purchase, and the agreement expires May 18, 2027. Members raised concerns about water credits and about rezoning company land for homes.

timeline.text: The chair said the water and land purchase must be discussed privately due to a nondisclosure agreement.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The county wants about $2.9 million in improvements to that system after the sale closes.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The system has two stream diversions, two shaft wells, one well, and three reservoirs.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The county is proposing to buy a private irrigation company's non-potable (not for drinking) water system.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The item will come back after the administration has and reviews the reports a member requested.
